messages:
rachel: Need a short, reproducible perf/W protocol for the marketplace entry. Partner wants one validated SKU + one fallback. Who can own the telemetry schema and the patch checklist?

tony: I'll take telemetry schema + partner parser. Recommend primary power source = external PDU (per-outlet if available), fallback = IPMI but annotate resolution. Sample at 250ms; warmup 60s; steady window 90s. Normalize published numbers to seq=256.

kai: I'll own kernel checklist and microbench. Propose three low-risk tweaks: thread-affinity, kv-prefetch, and async-copy fallback. Each must include a microbench and a regression smoke (100 prompts).

rachel: Acceptance gate idea: best-config toks/sec/W >= 88% of our certified baseline => "Validated"; 72-88% => "Supported (reduced perf)"; <72% -> do not list. Also require smoke eval and link to raw artifacts.

tony: Example partner CLI we'll give:
```
./rwd-partner --model redwood-7b --seq 256 --batch 32 --quant q4_0 \
  --telemetry /tmp/tel.json --pdu_csv /tmp/pdu.csv --sample-ms 250 --out /tmp/run.json
```
Includes power_source and power_resolution_ms fields.

kai: For kernel changes I'll provide a matrix with expected delta and risk label. If any change is non-upstreamable we annotate listing and require a canary flag.

ops-bot: Partner run scheduled on lab-5 (rp-5405001). ETA ~20m. Logs: https://ci.redwood/runtime/rp-5405001

tony: Run rp-5405001 finished. Quick summary: seq256 batch32 q4_0 -> 452 toks/s, steady watts 210W => 2.15 toks/s/W. p50 12ms, p90 26ms. Raw artifacts: s3://partners/artifacts/5405001/tel.json and pdu.csv. PR: https://git.redwood/partners/telemetry/pulls/78

kai: Patch matrix PR opened: https://git.redwood/partners/kernel/pulls/21. Microbench artifacts uploaded and linked in the PR. Thread-affinity + kv-prefetch combo gave +5% toks/sec/W with no regression.

rachel: Good. Tony/Kai please tag rp-5405001 in the PRs. I'll run the automated delta check and if we pass, draft the marketplace blurb using the exact measured toks/sec/W and link to the raw tel. Review Fri 9am PT. :rocket:
